applies.description: whether the playbook applies to this resource after checking the facts

summary.description: two or three sentences: what to do and why it is safe (or why not)

blockers.description: what stands in the way, verified, one per entry; empty when nothing does

step.description: what to do, specific to this resource (names, ids, sizes)

command.description: the aws CLI / kubectl / shell command when there is one, with the real ids filled in

verify.description: how to check the step worked before moving on

verify_sql.description: when a Steampipe table covers the check: one SELECT against the aws_* tables (no schema prefix) that shows whether the step worked, e.g. select flow_log_id, flow_log_status from aws_vpc_flow_log where resource_id in ('subnet-1'). Omit when no table covers it (Athena query state, Logs Insights, S3 listings).

risk.description: auto = reversible, approve = needs a human, report = never automate

est_monthly_saving.description: USD per month after checking real prices; 0 if unknown

needs_from_human.description: decisions or facts only the team can supply (owner confirmation, a maintenance window, a build of a binary)

concepts_used.description: ids of the team decision concepts from the prompt that shaped this answer
